name: word-lineage
description: Agent Skill that traces an English word's lineage phylogenetically (/word-lineage <word>): which layer it came from (native Germanic, Norse, Latin, French, other), the evidence for it (similarity to the source-language word, conjugation and morphology, synonym set, core vs borrowed vocabulary), and its literal meaning read off the tree, on a bundled NEXUS network of English and its donor languages. A word-choice mode (/word-lineage meaning: <phrase>) picks the synonym whose literal meaning fits.
